MXLEN == 32 -> MTVAL_WIDTH <= 32;

# in RV32, MTVAL must be able to hold a physical address if M-mode takes an exception
# that reports an address
# Since physical address width can be larger than 32 with Sv32, need to downsize MTVAL in that case
(
  MXLEN == 32 &&
  PHYS_ADDR_WIDTH > 32 &&
    (
      implemented?(ExtensionName::Sdext) ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_MTVAL_ON_BREAKPOINT ||
      REPORT_ENCODING_IN_MTVAL_ON_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_MTVAL_ON_LOAD_MISALIGNED ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_MTVAL_ON_STORE_AMO_MISALIGNED ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_MTVAL_ON_INSTRUCTION_MISALIGNED ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_MTVAL_ON_LOAD_ACCESS_FAULT ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_MTVAL_ON_STORE_AMO_ACCESS_FAULT ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_MTVAL_ON_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS_FAULT ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_MTVAL_ON_LOAD_PAGE_FAULT ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_MTVAL_ON_STORE_AMO_PAGE_FAULT ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_MTVAL_ON_INSTRUCTION_PAGE_FAULT
    )
) -> (MTVAL_WIDTH == 32);

REPORT_ENCODING_IN_MTVAL_ON_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION -> (MTVAL_WIDTH >= INSTR_ENC_SIZE);

# if M-mode is rv32, then every mode must be rv32
MXLEN == 32 -> xlen() == 32;

# can't get in to rv64 anywhere unless MXLEN is 64
xlen() == 64 -> MXLEN == 64;

# if it's just M-mode, then xlen is always MXLEN
(MXLEN == 64) && !implemented?(ExtensionName::U) -> xlen() == 64;

# if MXLEN is 64, and none of (V)UXLEN, (V)SXLEN can be 32, then xlen is always 64
(
  MXLEN == 64 &&
  implemented?(ExtensionName::H) &&
  !$array_includes?(VUXLEN, 32) &&
  !$array_includes?(VSXLEN, 32) &&
  !$array_includes?(UXLEN, 32) &&
  !$array_includes?(SXLEN, 32)
) -> xlen() == 64;

# if it's just M-mode, S-mode, and U-mode, MXLEN is 64, and neither UXLEN nor SXLEN can be 32, then xlen is always 64
(
  MXLEN == 64 &&
  implemented?(ExtensionName::S) &&
  !implemented?(ExtensionName::H) &&
  !$array_includes?(UXLEN, 32) &&
  !$array_includes?(SXLEN, 32)
) -> xlen() == 64;

# if it's just M-mode and U-mode, MXLEN is 64, and UXLEN can't be 32, then xlen is always 64
(
  MXLEN == 64 &&
  implemented?(ExtensionName::U) &&
  !implemented?(ExtensionName::S) &&
  !implemented?(ExtensionName::H) &&
  !$array_includes?(UXLEN, 32)
) -> xlen() == 64;

($array_size(SXLEN) == 1 && SXLEN[0] == 32) -> STVAL_WIDTH <= 32;

# in RV32, STVAL must be able to hold a physical address if S-mode takes an exception
# that reports an address
# Since physical address width can be larger than 32 with Sv32, need to downsize STVAL in that case
(
  ($array_size(SXLEN) == 1 && SXLEN[0] == 32) &&
  PHYS_ADDR_WIDTH > 32 &&
    (
      implemented?(ExtensionName::Sdext) ||
      implemented?(ExtensionName::Sstvala) ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_STVAL_ON_BREAKPOINT ||
      REPORT_ENCODING_IN_STVAL_ON_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_STVAL_ON_LOAD_MISALIGNED ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_STVAL_ON_STORE_AMO_MISALIGNED ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_STVAL_ON_INSTRUCTION_MISALIGNED ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_STVAL_ON_LOAD_ACCESS_FAULT ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_STVAL_ON_STORE_AMO_ACCESS_FAULT ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_STVAL_ON_INSTRUCTION_ACCESS_FAULT ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_STVAL_ON_LOAD_PAGE_FAULT ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_STVAL_ON_STORE_AMO_PAGE_FAULT ||
      REPORT_VA_IN_STVAL_ON_INSTRUCTION_PAGE_FAULT
    )
) -> (STVAL_WIDTH == 32);
